article: Post with the X API and Google Colab
scope: Compared the complete Japanese article and all twelve translations, including credential handling and previous exposure, current X API v2 authentication and post creation, API cost/access caveats, automation policy, code, terminology, links, and publication metadata.
findings: Removed hard-coded API credentials and advised treating previously published values as compromised; users should revoke and replace them if real.
Replaced legacy API v1.1/v2 snippets with a Colab Secrets and Tweepy Client example using OAuth 1.0a User Context and X API v2.
Added current official X API authentication, post creation, pay-per-use pricing, automation policy, Colab, and Tweepy references.
Clarified that running the cell publishes a real public post and may incur API fees; limited the example to manual one-post execution.
Preserved the original publication date (2023-04-08) and added lastmod (2026-11-24).
